It is simply you and i talking about the crypto world and going over the latest news now this happens to be the latest news we're going to jump into this article in a second but let's first set the stage shiba inu coin is down and so are the rest of the meme coins you guys any little green line is immediately of gains and then not only was that completely wiped out but we are so we're 50 percent lower than that level that we hit we've gone from a thousand points per coin to 530 points per coin because that is a 50 percent decline just since the beginning of january now any little gain that we see is immediately eaten up because of the fear. I don't know why, okay? I can't comprehend why investors are so afraid right now. But what I do understand is this is real. Emotion is real and it works in cycles, which is why I feel so comfortable going out and continuing to accumulate because I know that greed will return. Now when? I don't know that answer. How quickly? I don't know that answer. And if we're looking at, you know, for me to predict the future, I can't do it and neither can anybody else. We can simply say this would be the first time in the history, history of the world world that greed didn't return to the markets. So none the less we continue to watch these markets but lets see what's affecting the price of Shiba Inu coin doge coin and, and what these analysts believe is going to happen next. It says Dogecoin Shib and Pepe weaken amid a bearish market pressure. Bitcoins back down below $70,000, triggering liquidations and a meme coin selloff. Volatility in the market increases drastically, restricting the gain on meme coins. Now, Dogecoin Pepe and Shiba Inu coin retreated after Bitcoin slid beneath $70,000 and the wider crypto market declined 2.5% over 24 hours reducing the value to $2.33 trillion. Bitcoin remains under pressure, hovering below the key threshold as bearish sentiment strengthened. The downtrend accelerated as force liquidations hit $ million dollars in Bitcoin positions during the same period now Leverage trading is great when prices are moving higher, right? that's what gives you that massive run-up like it steps on a Rocket and you got that green candle that everybody gets excited about That's because you've got leverage traders that open up millions of dollars worth of positions for 1 1 1 dollar.. Its just as bad as when moving to the downside. Dogecoin's price fell again on saturday reflecting bitcoin's price slide as cautions spread across the crypto market the meme coin lost 2.87 percent 24 hours trading at nine cents during the session earlier the week dogecoin climbed to 10 cents but the rally quickly faded under renewed selling pressure and the conflict involving the united states israel iran Iran added volatility across major digital assets. Analysts indicate that Dogecoin has rolled back into its symmetrical triangle following an unsuccessful breakout. And you could see, false breakout right here, of course 3 days of declines. Yes that is exactly what Shiba Inu was looking at. You had a nice little breakout here coming up above the 10 day moving average, and then It is as though the bull cannot sustain a gain to save their lives. PEPE Can it hold this 300 ppt coin level amid growing bearish pressure? As of the reporting, The Pepe coin price traded at 334 points per coin on the four-hour chart and the token experienced a slight fall of 0.60 percent indicating short-term price behavior uh weakness the macd line is continuing to trade slightly below the signal line indicating a low level of momentum strength finally the relative strength index is at a level of 35 and this is almost in oversold territory, buyers should manage to push above 390 points, a short-term recovery may take off, and Shiba Inu Coin said Shiba Inu coin slipped 2% to 539 points per coin over the last 24 hours amid broad market weakness, the downturn reflects a broader crypto sell-off with bitcoin due to increasing concerns regarding macroeconomic pressure it this is the part that is so strange to me right increasing macroeconomic pressure guys what is the increasing macroeconomic pressure right Is it the conflict between US and Middle East? No, that is not resulting in any negativity, it has not and it won't. Is it tariffs? Fears of inflation rising because of these tariffs. Tariffs have been in place for a year now, and we have seen ZERO signs of inflation. Bitcoin is trading near a point of stabilization, about 68,000 and traders will be monitoring this during the following sessions. In the meantime, Shiba Inu co coin experienced a theatrical increase in its token burn rate with the same timeframe. Statistics indicate that the burn rate increased by 8,000%, destroying more than 3 million tokens in a single breath, and AnalystEye holding support near 526 points per coin, and this could open the door to 540 points per coin soon. 10% swing would be nice, but a 10 point swing, it's just 2%. Shiba Inu coin can absolutely move around 2%. The level that is crucial for Shib to hold is this 500 point per coin level. If this breaks, then it seems as though that's where the trend is going, right? We need something to reverse this trend if 500 points per coin breaks we have not seen those levels since prior to making a name for itself in 2021 it is crucial that shiba inu coin holds that support
